verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes APM/tracing docs but no explicit documentation of Datadog's dedicated Error Tracking feature — no mention of errors being grouped into issues, stack trace capture, release tracking, or regression detection algorithms. Only general APM/tracing (datadog-docs-23) and anomaly detection (Watchdog, datadog-docs-16) are cited, which don't concretely evidence this specific issue-grouping/regression workflow.
